baseline_models.focus_anchor: The enabling verb at word 2, self-placement at word 6, the open locative at word 8, and the paired willing verbs at words 9 and 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine enablement creates a field of viable stations; Yusuf exercises real local choice within that field, while the repeated willing construction places his choice inside the wider divine choice of mercy's recipients.

activation_trace.role: Supplies effective capacity and serves as the enabling condition for later self-placement.
Supplies the act of taking a station and converts capacity into situated agency.
Leaves the destination spatially indeterminate, making range rather than one residence salient.
Joins both willing clauses to selected objects and supports the nesting of human choice within divine choice.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf is given territory and may reside wherever he wants.
changed_reading.after: Yusuf receives a divinely enabled range in which his delegated choosing is genuine but remains nested inside God's wider choosing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reaching verb at word 10, mercy at word 11, and the no-loss reward clause at words 15 through 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mercy is routed to a selected recipient with the precision of an impact, while the closing clause prevents the value generated by good action from leaking away. Delivery and conservation form one economy.

activation_trace.role: Gives mercy a directed arrival at its mark rather than the character of diffuse favor.
Supplies tender mercy as the substance being deliberately delivered.
Defines the negated failure mode as value passing away or becoming irrecoverable.
Identifies the conserved value as recompense answering to work.
Anchors recompense in enacted good rather than status alone.

changed_reading.before: God grants mercy and promises not to withhold the reward of good people.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts a precise mercy-delivery system paired with a guarantee that enacted good cannot disappear from the economy of consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The self-stationing root at word 6 is followed by the explicit no-loss recompense clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside ordinary settlement, the station can resonate as something returning upon its bearer and matching deed with consequence. The achieved place is then not merely a gift after goodness but a form of goodness coming back without being lost.

activation_trace.role: Introduces a return upon the actor and lets emplacement carry a consequence-returning resonance.
Adds correspondence between counterparts and supports a deed-to-outcome matching mechanism.
The negated disappearance keeps the returning consequence from being broken or lost.
Makes work and its answering recompense explicit.
Supplies the good action whose consequence returns in changed form.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf's settlement and the reward maxim are adjacent but separable claims.
changed_reading.after: His new station can also be carried as a recompensive return in which enacted good comes back as a fitting, preserved consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier space is coercive and prolonged; the focus verse reverses that spatial condition into empowered self-stationing across an open range. The change is not only elevation in rank but restoration of spatial agency.

activation_trace.role: Supplies confinement in a bounded place as the initial spatial condition.
Adds prolonged remaining in place, intensifying the loss of spatial choice.
Provides the effective capacity that reverses prior spatial powerlessness.
Turns imposed placement into Yusuf's own act of taking a station.
Opens the formerly bounded spatial condition into an unspecified selectable range.

structural_cues: A bounded prison is introduced at 12:36 and paired with prolonged staying at 12:42; 12:56 replaces imposed location with an open locative and self-placement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confinement, delay, enablement, and self-placement; I supply the reversal arrow from coerced location to restored spatial agency. A live alternative is simple promotion after release without making spatial reversal thematic.

changed_reading.before: Enablement means that Yusuf gains high status and freedom of residence.
changed_reading.after: Enablement specifically reverses a history of coerced placement, converting a confined body into an agent who can distribute his presence across the land.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly stages another party trying to bend Yusuf's desire and self, then confirms his integrity. The focus verse's willing is therefore readable as rehabilitated agency: a will once pressured by solicitation is granted a legitimate field of action.

activation_trace.role: Makes desire and willing explicit in the prior contest over Yusuf's agency.
Supplies active solicitation as pressure exerted on that desire.
Locates the pressure at the level of Yusuf's own self rather than only an external act.
Supplies confirmed stability and integrity as the condition under which agency is restored.
Reintroduces willing in a sanctioned, productive domain and contrasts it with coerced desire.
Gives the rehabilitated will an open spatial scope in which to operate.

structural_cues: The confession at 12:51 repeats the solicitation and self constructions; vindication and appointment intervene before the focus verse grants a sphere for Yusuf's willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressured desire, the self under pressure, verified integrity, and later willing; I infer that the later spatial choice repairs the earlier assault on agency. The live alternative is that the willing clause denotes administrative latitude with no backward reference.

changed_reading.before: Where he wills describes broad personal or administrative liberty.
changed_reading.after: Where he wills also marks the public rehabilitation of an agency that resisted manipulation and can now choose within a legitimate sphere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding request and appointment concern guarded stores for the whole land. Against that frame, self-placement wherever needed becomes operational jurisdiction and mobile stewardship, not private residential privilege.

activation_trace.role: Supplies appointment by transforming a person into an office-bearing condition.
Defines the requested office as active custodianship rather than possession.
Makes watchful protection the function that spatial authority must perform.
Converts the requested custodial function into effective institutional capacity.
Provides the territorial field across which custodianship operates.
Makes station-taking a repeatable operational action within that field.
Allows deployment to remain responsive to need rather than tied to one fixed seat.

structural_cues: The focus verse directly follows Yusuf's request to be placed over the land's storehouses on the grounds of preservation and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, stores, guarding, territorial enablement, and flexible stationing; I infer the arrow from flexible stationing to a distributed logistics role. A live alternative is that the language only denotes secure residence and broad political rank.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf may settle anywhere because he now possesses exceptional freedom and status.
changed_reading.after: Yusuf can station himself wherever the custodial system requires, so freedom of place functions as infrastructure for public stewardship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agricultural plan grows, leaves, encloses, and preserves grain until rain and relief arrive. This sequence activates the focus verse's mercy as materially routed rescue and its no-loss clause as an anti-waste principle implemented through foresight.

activation_trace.role: Supplies managed growth as the material base of the rescue mechanism.
Turns deliberate leaving-in-place into a preservation operation rather than abandonment.
Adds protective enclosure, explaining how value survives the consuming years.
Supplies descending rain as the ecological form in which relief reaches the people.
Preserves the split root's distress-relief image and makes the same event social rescue as well as rainfall.
Echoes rain descending and settling, giving mercy a material arrival pattern.
Names the compassionate force expressed through the ecological and administrative chain.
Defines what foresight blocks: the disappearance of stored value and enacted good.

structural_cues: The ordered movement from cultivation at 12:47, through protected reserves at 12:48, to rain and relief at 12:49 precedes the appointment and focus verse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, deliberate retention, enclosure, rain-relief, mercy, and non-loss; I infer that Yusuf's administrative chain is one means by which mercy reaches its mark. The live alternative is to keep the agricultural plan and the theological maxim as parallel but unjoined layers.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is a general divine favor illustrated by Yusuf's promotion.
changed_reading.after: Mercy reaches people through an ecological-administrative chain that preserves growth against future consumption, making non-loss both moral assurance and public method.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth emerges, entitlement is fixed, integrity is confirmed, and Yusuf is extracted from prior contamination before he is established. The unusual repair branch of reward then reads the new station as a setting-right of a bent public history, not merely payment added afterward.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the emergence of previously obscured truth as the start of public repair.
Adds a fixed due or entitlement, allowing vindication to demand a consequential correction.
Confirms durable integrity as the basis for restoring Yusuf's standing.
Supplies purification after mixture, marking separation from the accusation that distorted his status.
Activates recompense as straightening and stabilizing what had been bent.
Locates the repair in Yusuf's changed public standing and condition.
Guarantees that neither prior integrity nor the correction answering it disappears.

structural_cues: Public confession and confirmation at 12:51 are followed by extraction for the king at 12:54 and establishment at 12:56.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, fixed right, integrity, purification, changed standing, and a repair branch under reward; I supply the arrow that establishment repairs the bent social record. The ordinary payment sense remains live and is cleaner morphologically.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf's office is a reward paid after his innocence becomes known.
changed_reading.after: The office also repairs a distorted public trajectory, straightening status around disclosed truth while preserving the ordinary recompense reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy first appears as the exception that interrupts the self's commanding pressure toward wrong; it then appears in the focus verse as a force reaching chosen recipients. The same mercy can therefore underwrite both inward moral government and outward public government.

activation_trace.role: Locates the earlier struggle in the inward faculty of judgment and impulse.
Gives the self's pressure an imperative force that requires restraint.
Supplies mercy as the stated interruption of inward moral pressure.
Carries that same compassionate force outward toward selected recipients.
Marks enacted good as the public fruit of inwardly governed agency.

structural_cues: Mercy interrupts the commanding self at 12:53, trust and office follow at 12:54 through 12:55, and mercy is redistributed socially at 12:56.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward command, mercy as exception, enacted good, and later public mercy; I infer that inward restraint enables trustworthy outward rule. A live alternative treats the two mercy statements as general formulas without a governance sequence.

changed_reading.before: Mercy in the focus verse is an external favor that grants Yusuf power.
changed_reading.after: Mercy first governs the agent from within and then, through the trustworthy agent, becomes public governance that reaches others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Yusuf is recognized as a doer of good while still confined, the focus verse connects establishment with preserved recompense, and the next verse names a better later recompense. Earthly office is therefore a real return but cannot exhaust the reward claim.

activation_trace.role: Places enacted good before release or office, separating moral identity from later status.
Recalls the earlier moral identity at the moment of worldly establishment.
Names the recompense whose preservation spans the change in status.
Repeats recompense beyond the focus verse and prevents office from closing the account.
Moves the reward horizon to a later and other register.
Ranks that later register as superior rather than merely additional.

structural_cues: The same good-doer root frames Yusuf in prison at 12:36 and the maxim at 12:56; the next verse repeats reward and explicitly places a better form later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pre-office goodness, worldly establishment, repeated recompense, and a better later register; I infer that the office is a partial manifestation rather than payment in full. A live alternative is that worldly mercy and later reward are categorically separate.

changed_reading.before: The no-loss maxim explains Yusuf's worldly rise as the reward for his goodness.
changed_reading.after: His rise manifests preserved recompense without exhausting it; goodness precedes office, and the account remains open into a better later horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped root for the verb at word 10, while the ordinary directed-arrival reading is morphologically cleaner. It remains anchored to the supplied split inventory and the adjacent mercy-reward construction; downstream prose should present it only as an experimental allotment resonance, not as a replacement derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reaching verb at word 10, mercy at word 11, and recompense at word 16.

activation_trace.role: Activates a specifically assigned share and recasts mercy's arrival as allotment.
Adds a fixed measure or basis, sharpening the idea that the share is proportioned.
Identifies mercy as what is experimentally heard as apportioned.
Adds the contextual image of a work-linked assigned return, connecting allotment to office and service.
Keeps the allotment resonance tied to recompense rather than arbitrary distribution.

changed_reading.after: At the exploratory split-root edge, mercy also resembles an assigned and measured share, with office and recompense appearing as apportioned responsibilities and returns.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The egg, womb, fertile ground, rain, and abode branches create a deliberately cross-domain image and are too distant to control lexical translation. They remain valid as a focus-anchored material analogy reinforced by the agricultural sequence; downstream prose should label this an incubatory image, not an etymological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Enablement at word 2, land at word 5, abode-taking at word 6, mercy at word 11, and the reaching verb at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Supplies protected internal incubation as the outlier's material starting point.
Turns the land into a receptive growing medium rather than only territory.
Provides the inhabitable station that contains and supports development.
Adds a generative enclosure and makes mercy habitat-forming.
Supplies descending moisture that completes the habitat's growth mechanism.
Shows growth emerging through rain and gives the material analogy contextual traction.

changed_reading.before: God places Yusuf securely in a territory and favors him.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, mercy forms a protected, fertile habitat in which Yusuf's capacity matures into public provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates noun branches for estate and vocation beneath a verbal no-loss construction. The roots remain exact and the storehouse context makes productive preservation visible; downstream prose should render it as an economic echo of the moral claim, never as its sole syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The no-loss verb at word 15, recompense at word 16, and enacted good at word 17.

activation_trace.role: Activates productive property as something protected from dissipation.
Adds vocation and earning, linking non-loss to sustained productive practice.
Supplies material safekeeping as the contextual means of preventing productive loss.
Adds active guarding and keeps the economic resonance tied to ethical custody.
Connects productive preservation back to work and its deserved return.
Prevents the economic echo from detaching from enacted good.

changed_reading.before: God never lets the moral reward of good action vanish.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary economic resonance, ethical custody also keeps productive estates, vocations, and their returns from being dissipated.

strongest_changes: The prison sequence turns enablement into a reversal from coerced location to restored spatial agency.
The storehouse appointment recasts flexible settlement as distributed public stewardship.
Cultivation, protected reserves, and rain-relief make mercy a materially routed rescue and non-loss an administrative method.
Vindication activates recompense as repair of a bent public status, while the next verse keeps reward from being exhausted by office.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained simultaneous readings of nested wills, precise mercy delivery, recompensive return, repaired status, and productive conservation. Split mappings and material branches preserved odd but traceable activations without displacing the ordinary senses.
remaining_uncertainties: The return-and-equivalence branches under self-placement may remain a secondary resonance rather than enter primary rendering.
The ecological and generative habitat reading is coherent but depends on cross-domain material analogy.
The split-root allotted-share reading is intentionally exploratory because the dominant mapped root gives the cleaner verbal mechanism.
The exact relation between worldly office and later reward remains open: partial manifestation and categorical separation are both live.
